test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

Some Sofas are Chair.

Some Chairs are Tables.

All Tables are Beds.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Sofas are Tables.

(II) Some Chairs are Beds.

(III) Some Beds are Sofas.

options.text: Both Conclusions II and III follow.
Both Conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
**Explanation:**

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02600ba2c7215d20c1443467a29603aff8e54d6e7a691d4318e7643203f90b52.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Sofas are Tables. → Does not follow (because some sofas are chair and some chairs are tables, so we cannot say that some sofas are definitely tables.)

(II) Some Chairs are Beds. → Follows (because some chairs are tables and all tables are beds, hence some chairs are definitely beds.) 

(III) Some Beds are Sofas. → Does not follow (because some chairs are beds (conclusion (II)) and some Sofas are Chair, so we cannot say that some beds are definitely sofas.)

Hence, “Only conclusion II follows”.
